# Waveform (`waveform`)

Audio waveform in five styles with playhead and selection.

Group: Charts & instruments. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/charts';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createWaveform` (types in `dist/web/charts/waveform.d.ts`): `.mh-waveform`: an audio waveform in five styles (`--bars | --half | --envelope | --line | --dots`), with theplayed part in the accent (or `--mh-series-N`), a playhead and a selection band. With `onSeek` it is a slider(click, drag, arrows, Page Up / Down, Home / End); with `onSelect`, dragging or Shift + arrows select a range.The web handle moves its own playhead and selection, then reports them.

```ts
export function createWaveform(options: WaveformOptions): WaveformHandle;

export interface WaveformOptions {
  /** Loudness per bucket, 0 to 1, oldest first (see `waveformPeaks`). */
  peaks: readonly number[];
  /** What it is ("Voice message", "Doorbell chime"). */
  label: string;
  style?: WaveformStyle;
  /** Length in seconds; with it the waveform shows the playhead and the played part. */
  duration?: number;
  /** Playhead in seconds. */
  position?: number;
  selection?: WaveformSelection | null;
  color?: ChartColor;
  size?: ChartSize;
  /** Makes it a slider: click, drag or arrow keys seek. */
  onSeek?: (time: number) => void;
  /** Dragging (or Shift + arrows) selects a range; Escape clears it. */
  onSelect?: (selection: WaveformSelection | null) => void;
  /** Arrow-key step in seconds (default 5); Page Up / Down move six steps. */
  step?: number;
  /** Formats times; default m:ss (h:mm:ss from an hour). */
  formatTime?: (seconds: number) => string;
}

export interface WaveformHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setPeaks(peaks: readonly number[]): void;
  setPosition(time: number): void;
  setSelection(selection: WaveformSelection | null): void;
  update(options: WaveformOptions): void;
  /** Removes the listeners. */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createWaveform } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const duration = 24;
// Loudness per bucket, 0 to 1; `waveformPeaks` makes these from decoded samples.
const peaks = Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => 0.15 + 0.8 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i / 2.3)));

let position = 0;
let timer: number | undefined;

const voice = createWaveform({
  peaks,
  label: 'Voice message',
  duration,
  position,
  onSeek: (time) => (position = time),
});

const play = createButton({
  label: 'Play',
  icon: 'play',
  size: 'small',
  onClick: () => {
    if (timer !== undefined) {
      clearInterval(timer);
      timer = undefined;
    } else {
      timer = window.setInterval(() => {
        position = position + 0.25 >= duration ? 0 : position + 0.25;
        voice.setPosition(position);
      }, 250);
    }
    play.setLabel(timer === undefined ? 'Play' : 'Pause');
  },
});

document.body.append(play.el, voice.el);
```

## React API

`Button` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createButton`.

```ts
export function Button({ variant, size, icon, trailingIcon, loading = false, fullWidth, disabled, className, type = 'button', children, ...rest }: ButtonProps);

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

`Waveform` (types in `dist/react/charts.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createWaveform`. Controlled: `position` and `selection` come from props; seeking and selecting call `onSeek` and `onSelect`.

```ts
export function Waveform({ className, ...options }: WaveformProps);

export interface WaveformProps extends WaveformOptions {
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Waveform } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const duration = 24;
// Loudness per bucket, 0 to 1; `waveformPeaks` makes these from decoded samples.
const peaks = Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => 0.15 + 0.8 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i / 2.3)));

export function WaveformExample() {
  const [position, setPosition] = useState(0);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => setPosition((p) => (p + 0.25 >= duration ? 0 : p + 0.25)), 250);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [playing]);
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon={playing ? 'pause' : 'play'} size="small" onClick={() => setPlaying(!playing)}>
        {playing ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
      </Button>
      <Waveform
        peaks={peaks}
        label="Voice message"
        duration={duration}
        position={position}
        onSeek={setPosition}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```
